Background

Buttigieg was mayor of South Bend, Indiana, and finished among the top candidates in the 2020 Democratic primary. He served as Transportation Secretary from 2021 to 2025.

Outlook

Buttigieg has said he leans toward running, but he told reporters in Denver he would have no news on 2028 anytime soon. He placed third in the Crooked Con straw poll and drew excitement from 26 percent of Democrats in the CNN/SSRS poll. Prediction markets price him near 5 percent, reflecting doubts about his support among Black voters ahead of a calendar that opens in South Carolina.
